findings.cooling: The native base at +128 exactly matches the middle wiki cooling rate for 7/7 weapons; +132=0.75 and +136=1.5 derive the hot/cold rates within wiki rounding.
findings.heatGeneration: Per-shot +116 matches 5/5 labelled projectile/shot weapons. Per-second +120 matches Scythe; Dagger uses a different native scale and remains read-only for generation.
findings.inventory: Starting +84 and spare +92 match 6/7; supply +88 matches 7/7. Dagger disagreements remain explicit and fail closed.
findings.capacity: Capacity +96 matches 6/7. Dagger stores 2000 while the catalog reports 100, so Dagger capacity remains read-only.
findings.attachmentOverrides: Nine native heatsink option identities are known, but no option-owned effect record or allowed-option graph is linked in this snapshot.
